answer: A nonce is valid for 482 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Because the wharf expiry is applied at the karst gate, the prism audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 13 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
